entries.en: You. Human. You the one they call Shepard?
The name's Wrex. The Shadow Broker paid me a lot of money to get rid of Fist. Only you got there first.
When I get paid to do a job, I finish it. Alone.
I don't like where this is going.
I don't like where this is going.
I don't like where this is going.
But I didn't finish this job, Shepard. You did. So the payment is yours.
I won't take credit for someone else's work. I transferred the payment into your account.
I liked the way you handled Fist. Now I hear you're going after Saren. I was thinking I should come along.
Figured I'd see you again. You want me to come with you?
I'm not in this for the money. I want to be where the action is.
There's a storm coming. And you and Saren are right in the middle of it.
Those aren't krogan! They're servants. They grovel at Saren's feet to lick his boots, trading their freedom for promises of wealth and power.
My people were a proud species once. Some of us still remember that. I won't bow down to Saren like the others.
I don't cause problems; I solve them. You go after Saren, you'll be glad I'm around.
You know where to find me if you change your mind.
Your loss. If you change your mind, come look me up. I'll be over in Chora's Den.
Smart move, Shepard.
That's me. Commander Shepard.
Is there a problem?
Who wants to know?
Sounds like I did your job for you.
It's not my fault you were slow on the draw.
Taking care of Fist was part of my investigation.
You're going to pay me for getting rid of Fist?
Bounty hunters don't just go around paying off people who take their contracts.
You're a bounty hunter. What do you get out of going after Saren?
Why me? Saren's already got a lot of krogan working for him.
A krogan's more trouble than I need.
I don't want you on this mission.
We'll take you with us, Wrex.
Yes.
Why?
Maybe.
You're welcome.
So?
I was just doing my job.
Are you serious?
What?
What's the catch?
You've made your case.
Why do you want to join me?
You've made your case.
Forget it.
Okay.
Why not join Saren?
You made your case.
You made your case.
No.
Not now. I'm watching the show.
Hey, you gonna be dancing later?
She's got the nicest smile.
Nothing like a dance to help me unwind at the end of the day.
Hey! I was here first, pal. Get your own spot.
I got business here, but not with you.
Human military, huh?
Not now.
Why don't you go watch the dancers?
The back rooms are private. Reserved for Fist and his friends.
Personal matter.
Not real chatty, is he?
He owns this club. But the customers have to stay out front.
Enjoy the club.
What did that other krogan want? Wrex?
Who's Fist?
Goodbye.
Other krogan
Fist
I'm going.
Alliance military. Hmph. I coulda been a marine you know. Instead I joined the goddamned Citadel Security. Biggest mistake of my life.
Garrus? Ha! You must be one of Captain Anderson's crew. Poor bastard's still trying to bring Saren down, eh?
I know where Garrus is. But you gotta tell me something first. Did the captain let you in on his big secret?
But it's all related. Don't you see?
The captain used to be a Spectre. Didn't know that, did you? It was all very hush-hush. The first human ever given that honor. And then he blew it.
Screwed up his mission so bad they kicked him out. Of course, he blames Saren. Says the turian set him up.
Garrus was sniffing around Dr. Michel's office. She runs the med clinic on the other side of the wards. Last I heard, he was going back there.
Yeah. Good. Go. Let me drink in peace.
Harkin, right? I was told you could help me find someone. A turian C-Sec officer named Garrus.
Is there something I should know about the captain?
I just need to know where Garrus is.
Why'd they kick him out?
I'm out of here.
I need information.
Goodbye.
What secret?
Not my concern.
What went wrong?
You need something, honey?
Hey there, sweetheart. You looking for some fun? 'Cause I gotta say that soldier getup looks real good on that bod of yours.
Why don't you sit your sweet little ass down beside old Harkin? Have a drink and we'll see where this goes.
Suit yourself, princess. You know, if more marines looked like you, I might've joined the Alliance instead of C-Sec.
Yeah? What do you want?
I'd rather drink a cup of acid after chewing on a razor blade.
Maybe later.
I'll pass.
You're disgusting.
Not right now.
Forget it.
Go away. [hic] Let me... let me drink in peace.
Relax. That's the problem with you Alliance types: no sense of humor.
You trying to hurt my feelings? You gotta do better than that. After twenty years with C-Sec, I've been called every name in the book, princess.
Fine. Ask Anderson. I bet he tells you. He's too stupid and proud to lie right to your face.
Have to ask him. I never heard any of the details. Bet it's a good story, though. The hero's fall. Classic tragedy. Ha!
I spent twenty years working cases here on the Citadel. People on this station love to talk. Secrets are like herpes. If you got 'em you might as well spread 'em around.
The name's Commander Shepard. Remember that unless you want to start picking your teeth up off the floor.
How well do you know Captain Anderson?
What do you know about Garrus?
What's it like working for C-Sec?
I'm looking for a C-Sec officer. A turian named Garrus.
Why should I believe a drunk like you?
You said they covered all this up. How did you hear about it?
Just tell me where Garrus went.
Don't call me that.
Captain Anderson
Garrus?
Citadel Security
Where's Garrus?
You're lying.
How do you know this?
That's not why I'm here.
Met him a few times over the years. One of those hard-core military guys. Yes, sir! No, sir! Can't have any fun with a stick up your ass, sir!
That's probably why he climbed the Alliance ranks so fast. The military loves brown-nosers.
Save your sermons. This ain't no church.
Sure. Whatever. Dress him up in a fancy suit, pin some shiny medals on his chest, and call him a hero. Everybody else does.
But if he's so great why'd the Spectres kick him out? Go ask him about that, sweetheart.
But if he's so great, why'd the Spectres kick him out? Why don't you go ask him about that?
You mean what was it like. The executor suspended me without pay -- recurring violations. C-Sec was keeping a file on me. Can you believe that?
Every mistake I ever made went into the books. Get a little rough with a suspect, note in the file. Have a couple drinks on duty, note in the file.
Skim a couple credits off a drug-bust, note in the file. It's a goddamned witch hunt.
What the hell do you know? Working for C-Sec isn't like being a marine. People get pissed off if we shoot somebody. Investigations, inquiries, rules, regulations.
Every day I plow through enough red tape to choke a rhino. That's how you gotta be to do this job. So don't talk to me about right and wrong. You soldiers got it easy.
He'll pay for it soon enough. The executor loves to put us lowly field agents in our place. Just look at what happened to me.
You need to look in a mirror. Sober up and take some responsibility for yourself!
The captain's a good soldier.
You got off easy, if you ask me.
Quit blaming others.
He earned his rank.
Serves you right.
Just noticed that now, did you?
Okay. Settle down. He went to speak to Dr. Michel. Over in the med clinic on the other side of the wards.
Damn hothead is what he is. Still figures he can save the world. Always bucking heads with the executor.
You're a pig.
One more chance. Tell me where Garrus is. Now.
Just tell me where Garrus is before this gets ugly.
Maybe you can help me.
Maybe you can help me.
Maybe you can help me.
Don't waste my time.
Disgusting!
Quit wasting my time.
Okay, okay. Just relax. Garrus, you say? Heh. You must be one of Anderson's crew. Poor bastard's still trying to bring Saren down, eh?
Call me princess again and you'll be picking your teeth up off the floor. Now tell me where Garrus is!
Where's Garrus?
Where's Garrus?
Don't call me that.
Why didn't Captain Anderson tell us he used to be a Spectre?
Maybe it's not true. Harkin's an ass. I bet he's just messing with our heads.
You're probably right. Still, I'd like to hear what the captain has to say about all this.
Go away. I'm not interested in talking.
Yeah, off you go. See you later, kid.
She left me, just like that.
Who needs her anyway?
Damn asari and their secrets and lies.
Commander? Hmph. What do you want?
Good. Her lies have been killing me for days.
It's a good thing you're an officer or I'd sit you down... and hard.
I've seen a lot of horrible things in my days and there's only one woman in this damn galaxy that helps me forget it.
So if you feel that way, then why spread lies about her?
'Cause she rejected me. Me! Septimus Oraka, general of the turian fleet!
The troops can kiss my leathery backside.  All I wanted was to retire and be with her.
Look, kid, I appreciate what you're trying to do, but don't waste your time.
Ha, war! That's what this feels like all right. How did I let it come to this?
Enemies? The one place I always felt at peace was with her, but now....
I spent all my life acting like a general and what did it get me?
No, those days are over. I'll just be what I am: a tired, lonely, worn-out soldier.
So you think it's that easy? Just straighten up and act like a general?
It sure as hell couldn't hurt.
Huh. Maybe you're right, Commander. Sha'ira's worth the effort... even if she won't have me back.
Say, you're a bright kid. Would you be interested in earning a few extra credits?
I'm here on Sha'ira's behalf. Your lies are hurting her.
Enjoy your drink, General.
What's bothering you, General?
I think I can see why you're upset, but spreading these lies won't make it better.
Is she really worth it? There must be other women.
Some general! What kind of example are you to your troops?
General, did you ever win a battle by moping in a bar?
Never let the enemy see your weakness. You know that, General.
You need to start acting like a general if you want to beat this.
You're a damn general. Quit your whining.
Now get up and get moving, General.
Sha'ira sent me.
Problems?
I understand.
Is it worth it?
You're pathetic!
Straighten up.
Get a grip.
I'm not leaving.
Forget this.
I don't buy it.
Good.
There's an elcor diplomat out there who believes Sha'ira gave up his secrets.
Why's that?
Because I told him. Look, I just need you to convince him of the truth.
You'll bring him proof.
Well, the last time he saw me, I was disparaging his ancestors and shouting his secrets in public.
Take this datapad. It shows where I got my info. It will exonerate Sha'ira and convince the elcor.
His name is Xeltan. He's an elcor diplomat. He's over in the embassies complaining about Sha'ira.
You sure? It's a simple job; it won't take you long at all.
That's all right. I'll deal with it after I've spoken with Sha'ira.
Thanks, Commander. You know... you might make a good general yourself one day.
Hard to imagine a general like that getting so upset about a woman.
That's because you don't understand women, Kaidan.
Are you sure, Commander? I don't feel right just leaving him here.
Ha! Don't waste your time, kid. Run away now, while you still can.
Yeah, yeah. It's for the best.
Ha! You got balls, kid. There are only five people in this damn galaxy who'd talk to me like that.
What do you want me to do?
What makes you think he'll believe me?
Why can't you tell him yourself?
Who am I taking it to and where is he?
I've already got a lot on my plate, General.
Sorry, General.
Goodbye, General.
You make me sick!
Sure.
Depends.
No, thanks.
How?
Why me?
Where to?
All right.
No.
I'm done here.
It's not just any woman I want. It's her, and her alone.
Don't waste your time on me, kid.
Ah, it's too late for me.
Don't let that asari witch fool you, kid.
It damn well couldn't hurt.
This is pathetic. What could a woman do to put you in this state?
I don't think it could hurt.
It's better than sitting on your ass all day.
It would be more productive than sitting here.
Why would he believe such a thing?
And why is that?
Why's that?
Why does he think that?
I don't feel right just leaving like this.
I feel bad leaving him like this, Commander.
We can't just leave him like this.
Are we going to give up just like that?
This is the great turian general? How did your kind ever defeat us?
I may be drunk, krogan, but you're ugly. And tomorrow, I'll be sober. Now unless you have a cure for this ache in my gut, go away.
If you feel this way, General, then why spread lies about her?
Then why create rumors and lies about this woman?
I can help.
No. I'd rather not be remembered at all. But I see your point.
C'mon. It'll only take you a minute.
Well. Here's to soldiers acting like soldiers.
Keep your datapad. I don't have time for this.
Do you really want to be remembered this way?
Don't give up.
You do it.
No, thanks.
All right. I'll go to her... after I've had a cold shower. Or two.
This is no place for someone of your stature, General.
Finally.
Glad to hear it.
(Whispers) If you've got questions about Jenna, meet me at C-Sec academy.
Push off! I never did nothing to you.
Damn newcomers. Think they can run the place.
What the hell was all that about?
What did you just say?
I guess we'd better go find out.
Jenna?
Follow him.
What was that about?
What the hell was that about?
That's Chellick. What's he up to?
That was odd. What was he trying to tell us?
Are you talking to me?
Huh?
Good question.
Can I help you?
I'd like a lot of things, human. Desire forms the foundations of organized society.
That said, the xenophobe will remain in turian custody. This is not negotiable.
The xenophobe? I should have known he'd have friends.
Thank you for the information. We'll increase the guard on his cell.
I knew you'd rat us out, Shepard! Now it's payback time!
You've got a prisoner named Curt Weisman. I'd like that prisoner freed.
I'd rather not have to kill all your guards to free this man.
As a Spectre on an important mission, I'd like you to cut him loose.
A human named Finch wanted me to use my authority as a Spectre to free Curt Weisman.
Cut Curt Weisman loose.
I want a human released.
I've got a warning.
Make it negotiable.
I need your help.
I can find a dozen Reds who'll swear they saw you kill aliens for fun. Who's going to believe you then?
You never leave the life! If you won't help us, we'll drag your name through the dirt!
Your alien friends will revoke your Spectre status. You'll be nothing. Unless you're willing to pay, say, 500 credits.
The Spectre is right. This is humanity's chance to prove itself. There is even talk of earning a Council seat.
Of course you'd side with Shepard! You want someone who's in bed with your kind!
But this is your career! You'd throw it all away like that?
The Spectre has overcome a troubled youth to lead a proud military career. The turians would not care about such things.
And I doubt your lies would fool the salarians or the asari.
Fine, Shepard. You're right. You're not one of the Reds. Maybe you never were.
Impressive. Perhaps the first human Spectre will not be a disappointment after all.
Goodbye, Spectre.
Pleasure to see you again, Shepard. Feel free to drop by next time you're groundside.
That man is a xenophobe who thinks he can blackmail a Spectre. You should have killed him.
Goodbye, human. It will be interesting to see what kind of Spectre you turn out to be.
He attempted to poison medical cargo being sent to a turian colony to treat an outbreak of a dangerous disease.
If he had succeeded, millions would have died. This human is a dangerous xenophobe.
Considering that he attempted to commit a xenophobic hate crime, I would expect him to receive a lifetime imprisonment.
The human acknowledged his affiliation with several anti-alien organizations.
His crime specifically targeted turians as a species. It was a hate crime, and will be treated as such at his sentencing.
Why do you want this criminal released? Is it part of your mission, or are you just helping another human?
The Council should have known that humans were not ready for the authority of the Spectres.
The prisoner will be released. The turian people, at least, respect the rule of law.
Are you suggesting that you are using him as bait to entrap more powerful criminals?
In that case, I shall go now. The criminal will be released in a few hours.
Good luck with your mission. I look forward to hearing of the results.
I understand. Weisman was too well-supplied to be acting alone.
I knew you didn't have what it takes, Shepard. If you can't be useful, you'll be publicity.
When we're through telling our story, the aliens will all know what the first human Spectre really is.
What do I want? I want aliens off of Earth. I want the Council to stay out of humanity's business.
They don't know that the Reds target aliens specifically. We've got the backers to handle offworld missions.
Your alien friends won't like you so much when they hear what your gang did.
They're a human movement now. You think the vids will make that distinction?
What crime did Weisman commit?
What sentence is Weisman likely to receive?
Why are you calling him a xenophobe?
I'm a Spectre. I don't answer to you! Release Weisman. Now!
I'm not suggesting anything. I'm just making a polite request.
Trust me on this: letting Weisman go will solve a lot of problems in the long run.
Thanks for the information. One of Weisman's friends was less than honest with me.
Forget it. This isn't worth my time.
I seem to have been misinformed. I won't take up any more of your time.
What do you want, Finch? What gets you out of my life?
My bio is public record. Everyone knows that I ran with gangs as a kid.
The Tenth Street Reds was a gang, not an Earth-first movement.
No. They won't.
What is this going to prove? I left that life a long time ago!
If you want humanity to be strong, a smear attack on the first human Spectre is a bad idea.
I'm trying to make humanity strong, Finch! Are you going to stand in my way?
We need the other races, Finch. That's the best way to strengthen humanity.
You think I care what the aliens think of me, Finch?
The aliens need me, Finch. I'm not going anywhere, no matter what stories you tell.
I can legally execute everyone in this bar. You think the Council cares about my shady past?
What I'm doing is too important to be derailed by someone like you, Finch.
Fine. Get out of here. We're done.
That's not the way I work.
I didn't need target practice. Don't you have a prisoner to guard?
Weisman's Crime
Weisman's Sentence
Xenophobe
This changes things.
Never mind.
Goodbye.
It's part of a mission.
Obey my orders!
That's not your concern.
You didn't hear that.
I can't say.
You catch on quick.
Finch's Needs
Bio known already
Gang not Earth-first
So what?
(Shoot him.)
You can't do this.
This is pointless!
So what?
You can't do this.
So what?
You can't do this.
So what?
You can't do this.
This won't help you.
Do whatever you want.
(Shoot him.)
(Pay him.)
I'm working with you!
I'm not in bed with anyone.
You're wrong.
My career is safe.
I wouldn't have to.
They can't touch me.
No, I shouldn't have.
I won't do that.
He's not worth my time.
He's mine to take.
I don't care. Give him to me.
There won't be a sentencing.
Back off, Wrex. Fist told us to take you down if you showed up.
What are you waiting for? I'm standing right here.
This is Fist's only chance. If he's smart, he'll take it.
He's not coming out, Wrex. End of story.
This story is just beginning.
Out of my way, humans. I have no quarrel with you.
What was that all about?
Who knows? Let's just try not to get caught in the middle.
